content: Shuhi tami Bildad ni a pathung teh,

content.text: Nâsittouh maw he e hnonaw heh dei han,
na pahni dawk hoi ka tâcawt e lawk hah athakaawme kahlî patetlah ao han.
Cathut ni kalan hoeh lah lawk a ceng boimaw,
nahoeh pawiteh, Athakasaipounge ni, lannae a kamlang takhai boimaw.
Na capanaw ni ama taranlahoi yon awh pawiteh,
kâtapoenae kecu dawk a tâkhawng han.
Cathut hah atangcalah hoi, na tawng teh,
Athakasaipounge koevah, kâheinae na sak pawiteh,
Tamikathoung tamikalan lah na awm pawiteh,
nang hanelah atu roeroe thaw vaiteh,
lanae hmuen koe hawinae na coe sak han.
Na kamtawngnae a thoung nakunghai,
na poutnae a len katang han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, pahrennae hoi a yan e hnonaw hah pakhingpalang haw,
na mintoenaw ni a hmu e hnonaw hah pouk haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, paduem e tami la o awh teh,
banghai panuek awh hoeh. Bangdawk tetpawiteh, talai van e hnin tha naw teh,
tâhlip patetlah doeh ao.
Ahnimae lungthin thung hoi ka tâcawt e lawknaw ni, na dei pouh awh teh,
na cangkhai hoeh namaw.
Tuinawk laipalah lungpum a roung thai han namaw.
Tui laipalah capi teh a roung thai han namaw.
A hring nah tâtueng hoeh nakunghai,
alouke akungnaw hlak palang a kamyai.
Cathut kapahnimnaw e a lamthung teh, hot patetlah ao.
Tami kahawihoehnaw e ngaihawinae teh a kahma han.
A kâuepkhai awh e teh, tâkhawng pouh lah ao han,
a kâuepkhainae teh, Bombarui patetlah doeh ao.
A im dawk a kamngawi ei kangdout thai hoeh.
Kacakcalah a kuet ei pou cak thai ma hoeh.
Khobetnae koe dikkahringcala a roung teh,
a kangnaw ni takha koung tahloi awh.
A tangpha ni talung khakdeng teh,
talung um vah a tangpha a payang nahane a tawng.
Amae hmuen koehoi phawk lah ao torei teh,
pou kacak mahoeh, telah a kâpahnawt han.
Khenhaw! het hateh, lunghawinae lamthung lah a o,
talai dawk hoi aloukenaw hah a pâw han.
Khenhaw! Cathut ni toun han kaawm hoeh e na tâkhawng hoeh vaiteh,
thoe ka sak e teh kangdout sak mahoeh.
Na kâko teh panuinae hoi akawi sak vaiteh,
na pahni hai lunghawinae lawk hoi akawi sak han.
Nang kahmuhmanaw hah yeiraipo sak vaiteh,
tamikathoutnaw e rim teh awm mahoeh toe telah a ti.
